verdict.rationale: Docs confirm you can create transactions directly from the Paddle dashboard (no code) via 'you may also create your own transactions using the API or Paddle dashboard,' which implies a dashboard-generated checkout/payment flow, but there is no explicit documentation of a shareable 'payment link' product feature or guarantee of immediate selling with zero setup. missing for 10: explicit payment-link feature docs, confirmation that dashboard-created transactions produce a shareable URL, and evidence of zero-setup time-to-first-sale.
